tools.name: flight_status
tools.description: Live status of a flight that is in the air now, by callsign or flight number as broadcast (e.g. UAL1, BAW117, DAL2540): route, progress, altitude, speed and estimated arrival. Free, no key.

tools.name: flight_on_date
tools.description: What happened to a flight on a given day within the last 7 days: departure and arrival airports, scheduled and actual take-off, delay in minutes, status, aircraft. Free, no key. Older dates: point the user to the flight record at the returned link.

tools.name: airport_board
tools.description: Live departures and arrivals board for an airport (ICAO like KJFK or IATA like JFK): flight, other airport, status, time. Free, no key.

tools.name: aircraft_info
tools.description: An aircraft by registration (e.g. N12345, G-EUPT) or Mode-S hex (e.g. a1b2c3): type, operator, where it is now if flying, and its flights in the last 7 days. Free, no key.

tools.name: aircraft_overhead
tools.description: Aircraft flying right now within radius_km (max 30) of a latitude/longitude, nearest first: callsign, type, altitude, speed. Free, no key.

tools.name: live_aircraft_near
tools.description: Aircraft currently airborne within radius_km of a latitude/longitude, nearest first, with callsign, altitude, heading, speed and type. 10 credits.

tools.name: aircraft_track
tools.description: Positions of one aircraft (Mode-S hex, e.g. a1b2c3) over the last minutes (5 to 1440). 20 credits.

tools.name: flight_history
tools.description: Past legs of a flight number/callsign as flown (e.g. UAL1, BAW117): dates, airports, times, aircraft. 20 credits.

tools.name: flight_reliability
tools.description: On-time performance for a flight number, a route (e.g. KJFK-KLAX or JFK-LAX) or a departure airport over the last 7 to 90 days (US airspace, FAA SWIM). Give exactly one of flight, route, airport. 20 credits.

tools.name: overhead_summary
tools.description: How many aircraft passed within km of a point over the last 1 to 3 days: passes per day, lowest pass, busiest hour (UTC), night passes, types, operators, rarest visitor. 20 credits.
